target: Integer Carathéodory Property for every fixed-root directed spanning-arborescence polytope
accepted_conclusions: Cactus after root deletion implies membership in C and therefore ICP, including finite parallel arcs.
Every rooted directed multigraph on at most four vertices belongs to C.
The explicit five-vertex eight-arc graph is outside C; five is the sharp vertex-count threshold.
The same five-vertex polytope has ICP by the explicit TU lift and the Gijswijt–Regts coordinate-projection theorem.
remaining_gap: Neither a proof nor a counterexample for ICP of arbitrary rooted-arborescence polytopes is established.
